args:
set -eu
NS="{{workflow.parameters.appNamespace}}"
DEADLINE=$(($(date +%s) + ${READINESS_WAIT_SECONDS:-900}))
echo "[readiness-check] Waiting for all pods in namespace $NS to reach Running/Succeeded..."
while [ "$(date +%s)" -lt "$DEADLINE" ]; do
	if ! kubectl get ns "$NS" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		echo "[readiness-check] Namespace $NS not found yet; retrying..."
		sleep 5
		continue
	fi

	TOTAL=$(kubectl get pods -n "$NS" --no-headers 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
	if [ -z "$TOTAL" ] || [ "$TOTAL" -eq 0 ]; then
		echo "[readiness-check] No pods created yet in $NS; retrying..."
		sleep 5
		continue
	fi

	NOT_READY=$(kubectl get pods -n "$NS" --no-headers 2>/dev/null | awk '$3!="Running" && $3!="Succeeded" && $3!="Completed" {c++} END {print c+0}')
	RUNNING=$(kubectl get pods -n "$NS" --no-headers 2>/dev/null | awk '$3=="Running" || $3=="Succeeded" || $3=="Completed" {c++} END {print c+0}')

	echo "[readiness-check] Pods status: $RUNNING/$TOTAL in Running/Succeeded"
	if [ "$NOT_READY" -eq 0 ]; then
		echo "[readiness-check] ✓ All pods in namespace $NS are Running/Succeeded"
		exit 0
	fi

	kubectl get pods -n "$NS" --no-headers 2>/dev/null | awk '$3!="Running" && $3!="Succeeded" && $3!="Completed" {print "[readiness-check] waiting:", $1, $3, $2}' | head -n 6 || true
  sleep 5
done
echo "[readiness-check] ⚠ Timeout waiting for all pods; continuing workflow to avoid deadlock"
exit 0

apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
description:
  message: |
    Scales a Deployment/StatefulSet identified by label to zero replicas, then
    restores its original replica count. Mirrors ITBench SRE scenario
    "scaled-to-zero-kubernetes-workload" (fault library index 20).
kind: ChaosExperiment
metadata:
  name: scaled-to-zero-kubernetes-workload
  labels:
    name: scaled-to-zero-kubernetes-workload
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: litmus
    app.kubernetes.io/component: chaosexperiment
    app.kubernetes.io/version: ci
spec:
  definition:
    scope: Namespaced
    permissions:
      - apiGroups: [""]
        resources: ["pods", "events"]
        verbs: ["create", "get", "list", "patch", "update"]
      - apiGroups: ["apps"]
        resources: ["deployments", "statefulsets", "deployments/scale", "statefulsets/scale"]
        verbs: ["get", "list", "patch", "update"]
      - apiGroups: ["litmuschaos.io"]
        resources: ["chaosengines", "chaosexperiments", "chaosresults"]
        verbs: ["create", "list", "get", "patch", "update", "delete"]
    image: "litmuschaos/k8s:latest"
    imagePullPolicy: Always
    command:
      - /bin/sh
    args:
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        # The chaos-operator on this cluster declares APP_NAMESPACE/APP_LABEL/APP_KIND
        # as env var names but never populates their values from
        # ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo -- verified empirically (a real ChaosEngine
        # submission mistargeted an unrelated deployment because both vars were
        # empty). This operator version instead sets a single combined TARGETS var,
        # format "<kind>:<namespace>:[<label-selector>]:<mode>". Derive the vars
        # every fault-injection script here still expects from it, and only fall
        # back to whatever APP_KIND/APP_NAMESPACE/APP_LABEL already say if TARGETS
        # isn't set (e.g. a future/different operator version that does populate
        # them directly).
        if [ -n "${TARGETS:-}" ]; then
          APP_KIND=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f1)
          APP_NAMESPACE=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f2)
          APP_LABEL=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f3 | tr -d '[]')
        fi
        echo "Resolving target ${APP_KIND} in ns=${APP_NAMESPACE} label=${APP_LABEL}"
        TARGET=$(kubectl get "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" -l "${APP_LABEL}" -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
        if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
          echo "no ${APP_KIND} found matching label ${APP_LABEL} in ${APP_NAMESPACE}" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        ORIG_REPLICAS=$(kubectl get "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "$TARGET" -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')
        ORIG_REPLICAS=${ORIG_REPLICAS:-1}
        echo "Target=${TARGET} originalReplicas=${ORIG_REPLICAS}"

        echo "Injecting: scaling ${TARGET} to 0 replicas"
        kubectl scale -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "${APP_KIND}/${TARGET}" --replicas=0

        echo "Holding fault for ${TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION}s"
        sleep "${TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION}"

        echo "Reverting: scaling ${TARGET} back to ${ORIG_REPLICAS} replicas"
        kubectl scale -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "${APP_KIND}/${TARGET}" --replicas="${ORIG_REPLICAS}"
    env:
      # Injected by the chaos-operator from ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo
      - name: APP_NAMESPACE
        value: ""
      - name: APP_LABEL
        value: ""
      - name: APP_KIND
        value: "deployment"

      - name: TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION
        value: "300"

    labels:
      name: scaled-to-zero-kubernetes-workload
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: litmus
      app.kubernetes.io/component: experiment-job
      app.kubernetes.io/version: ci

apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
description:
  message: |
    Patches a container's readinessProbe to probe an unreachable port (default
    40), causing the pod to stay in a NotReady state, then restores the original
    probe (or removes it if none existed). Mirrors ITBench SRE scenario
    "misconfigured-kubernetes-workload-container-readiness-probe" (index 49).
kind: ChaosExperiment
metadata:
  name: misconfigured-kubernetes-workload-container-readiness-probe
  labels:
    name: misconfigured-kubernetes-workload-container-readiness-probe
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: litmus
    app.kubernetes.io/component: chaosexperiment
    app.kubernetes.io/version: ci
spec:
  definition:
    scope: Namespaced
    permissions:
      - apiGroups: [""]
        resources: ["pods", "events"]
        verbs: ["create", "get", "list", "patch", "update"]
      - apiGroups: ["apps"]
        resources: ["deployments", "statefulsets"]
        verbs: ["get", "list", "patch", "update"]
      - apiGroups: ["litmuschaos.io"]
        resources: ["chaosengines", "chaosexperiments", "chaosresults"]
        verbs: ["create", "list", "get", "patch", "update", "delete"]
    image: "litmuschaos/k8s:latest"
    imagePullPolicy: Always
    command:
      - /bin/sh
    args:
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        # The chaos-operator on this cluster declares APP_NAMESPACE/APP_LABEL/APP_KIND
        # as env var names but never populates their values from
        # ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo -- verified empirically (a real ChaosEngine
        # submission mistargeted an unrelated deployment because both vars were
        # empty). This operator version instead sets a single combined TARGETS var,
        # format "<kind>:<namespace>:[<label-selector>]:<mode>". Derive the vars
        # every fault-injection script here still expects from it, and only fall
        # back to whatever APP_KIND/APP_NAMESPACE/APP_LABEL already say if TARGETS
        # isn't set (e.g. a future/different operator version that does populate
        # them directly).
        if [ -n "${TARGETS:-}" ]; then
          APP_KIND=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f1)
          APP_NAMESPACE=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f2)
          APP_LABEL=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f3 | tr -d '[]')
        fi
        echo "Resolving target ${APP_KIND} in ns=${APP_NAMESPACE} label=${APP_LABEL}"
        TARGET=$(kubectl get "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" -l "${APP_LABEL}" -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
        if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
          echo "no ${APP_KIND} found matching label ${APP_LABEL} in ${APP_NAMESPACE}" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        CONTAINER="${TARGET_CONTAINER:-$TARGET}"
        echo "Target=${TARGET} container=${CONTAINER}"

        # Capture original probe — empty string means no probe existed
        ORIG_PROBE=$(kubectl get "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "$TARGET" \
          -o jsonpath="{.spec.template.spec.containers[?(@.name=='${CONTAINER}')].readinessProbe}")
        echo "Original readinessProbe: ${ORIG_PROBE:-<none>}"

        BROKEN_PROBE="{\"failureThreshold\":3,\"httpGet\":{\"path\":\"${PROBE_PATH}\",\"port\":${PROBE_PORT},\"scheme\":\"HTTP\"},\"periodSeconds\":5,\"successThreshold\":1,\"timeoutSeconds\":3}"
        echo "Injecting: setting broken readinessProbe on ${CONTAINER} (port=${PROBE_PORT} path=${PROBE_PATH})"
        kubectl patch "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "$TARGET" --type=strategic \
          -p "{\"spec\":{\"template\":{\"spec\":{\"containers\":[{\"name\":\"${CONTAINER}\",\"readinessProbe\":${BROKEN_PROBE}}]}}}}"

        echo "Holding fault for ${TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION}s"
        sleep "${TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION}"

        # Revert: null removes the field (strategic-merge-patch semantics); otherwise restore original
        if [ -z "$ORIG_PROBE" ]; then
          PROBE_JSON="null"
        else
          PROBE_JSON="$ORIG_PROBE"
        fi
        echo "Reverting readinessProbe to original"
        kubectl patch "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "$TARGET" --type=strategic \
          -p "{\"spec\":{\"template\":{\"spec\":{\"containers\":[{\"name\":\"${CONTAINER}\",\"readinessProbe\":${PROBE_JSON}}]}}}}"
    env:
      # Injected by the chaos-operator from ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo
      - name: APP_NAMESPACE
        value: ""
      - name: APP_LABEL
        value: ""
      - name: APP_KIND
        value: "deployment"

      # container name to patch; defaults to the workload name if unset
      - name: TARGET_CONTAINER
        value: ""

      # broken probe parameters matching ITBench's own fixture
      - name: PROBE_PATH
        value: "/ready"
      - name: PROBE_PORT
        value: "40"

      - name: TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION
        value: "300"

    labels:
      name: misconfigured-kubernetes-workload-container-readiness-probe
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: litmus
      app.kubernetes.io/component: experiment-job
      app.kubernetes.io/version: ci

apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
description:
  message: |
    Replaces a Service's first port targetPort with a broken value (default
    9999), causing traffic to be routed to a closed port, then restores the
    original targetPort. Mirrors ITBench SRE scenario
    "modified-target-port-kubernetes-service" (index 30).
kind: ChaosExperiment
metadata:
  name: modified-target-port-kubernetes-service
  labels:
    name: modified-target-port-kubernetes-service
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: litmus
    app.kubernetes.io/component: chaosexperiment
    app.kubernetes.io/version: ci
spec:
  definition:
    scope: Namespaced
    permissions:
      - apiGroups: [""]
        resources: ["pods", "events", "services"]
        verbs: ["create", "get", "list", "patch", "update"]
      - apiGroups: ["litmuschaos.io"]
        resources: ["chaosengines", "chaosexperiments", "chaosresults"]
        verbs: ["create", "list", "get", "patch", "update", "delete"]
    image: "litmuschaos/k8s:latest"
    imagePullPolicy: Always
    command:
      - /bin/sh
    args:
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        # The chaos-operator on this cluster declares APP_NAMESPACE/APP_LABEL/APP_KIND
        # as env var names but never populates their values from
        # ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo -- verified empirically (a real ChaosEngine
        # submission mistargeted an unrelated deployment because both vars were
        # empty). This operator version instead sets a single combined TARGETS var,
        # format "<kind>:<namespace>:[<label-selector>]:<mode>". Derive the vars
        # every fault-injection script here still expects from it, and only fall
        # back to whatever APP_KIND/APP_NAMESPACE/APP_LABEL already say if TARGETS
        # isn't set (e.g. a future/different operator version that does populate
        # them directly).
        if [ -n "${TARGETS:-}" ]; then
          APP_NAMESPACE=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f2)
          APP_LABEL=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f3 | tr -d '[]')
        fi
        # ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo.appkind is CRD-validated to a fixed enum
        # (deployment|statefulset|daemonset|deploymentconfig|rollout|job) --
        # "service" is rejected outright at admission time. This fault always
        # targets a service, never any other kind, so hardcode it here instead
        # of trusting TARGETS' kind component (the ChaosEngine submission uses
        # a dummy CRD-valid appkind like "deployment" purely to satisfy the
        # schema; only appns/applabel need to vary per submission).
        APP_KIND="service"
        echo "Resolving target ${APP_KIND} in ns=${APP_NAMESPACE} label=${APP_LABEL}"
        TARGET=$(kubectl get "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" -l "${APP_LABEL}" -o jsonpath='{.items[0].metadata.name}')
        if [ -z "$TARGET" ]; then
          echo "no ${APP_KIND} found matching label ${APP_LABEL} in ${APP_NAMESPACE}" >&2
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Target=${TARGET}"

        ORIG_PORT=$(kubectl get "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "$TARGET" -o jsonpath='{.spec.ports[0].targetPort}')
        echo "Original targetPort: ${ORIG_PORT}"

        echo "Injecting: setting targetPort to ${BROKEN_TARGET_PORT}"
        kubectl patch "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "$TARGET" --type=json \
          -p "[{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/spec/ports/0/targetPort\",\"value\":${BROKEN_TARGET_PORT}}]"

        echo "Holding fault for ${TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION}s"
        sleep "${TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION}"

        echo "Reverting: restoring targetPort to ${ORIG_PORT}"
        kubectl patch "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" "$TARGET" --type=json \
          -p "[{\"op\":\"replace\",\"path\":\"/spec/ports/0/targetPort\",\"value\":${ORIG_PORT}}]"
    env:
      # Injected by the chaos-operator from ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo
      - name: APP_NAMESPACE
        value: ""
      - name: APP_LABEL
        value: ""
      - name: APP_KIND
        value: "service"

      # broken targetPort value; must not be in use by the target pod
      - name: BROKEN_TARGET_PORT
        value: "9999"

      - name: TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION
        value: "300"

    labels:
      name: modified-target-port-kubernetes-service
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: litmus
      app.kubernetes.io/component: experiment-job
      app.kubernetes.io/version: ci

apiVersion: litmuschaos.io/v1alpha1
description:
  message: |
    Patches the OpenTelemetry Demo's 'flagd-config' ConfigMap, setting a named
    feature flag's defaultVariant (e.g. to "on"), then restores its original
    value. Mirrors ITBench SRE scenario "opentelemetry-demo-feature-flag"
    (fault library index 18).
kind: ChaosExperiment
metadata:
  name: opentelemetry-demo-feature-flag
  labels:
    name: opentelemetry-demo-feature-flag
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: litmus
    app.kubernetes.io/component: chaosexperiment
    app.kubernetes.io/version: ci
spec:
  definition:
    scope: Namespaced
    permissions:
      - apiGroups: [""]
        resources: ["configmaps"]
        verbs: ["get", "patch"]
      - apiGroups: ["litmuschaos.io"]
        resources: ["chaosengines", "chaosexperiments", "chaosresults"]
        verbs: ["create", "list", "get", "patch", "update", "delete"]
    image: "litmuschaos/k8s:latest"
    imagePullPolicy: Always
    command:
      - /bin/sh
    args:
      - -c
      - |
        set -eu
        # The chaos-operator on this cluster declares APP_NAMESPACE/APP_LABEL/APP_KIND
        # as env var names but never populates their values from
        # ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo -- verified empirically (a real ChaosEngine
        # submission mistargeted an unrelated deployment because both vars were
        # empty). This operator version instead sets a single combined TARGETS var,
        # format "<kind>:<namespace>:[<label-selector>]:<mode>". Derive the vars
        # every fault-injection script here still expects from it, and only fall
        # back to whatever APP_KIND/APP_NAMESPACE/APP_LABEL already say if TARGETS
        # isn't set (e.g. a future/different operator version that does populate
        # them directly).
        if [ -n "${TARGETS:-}" ]; then
          APP_NAMESPACE=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f2)
          APP_LABEL=$(echo "$TARGETS" | cut -d: -f3 | tr -d '[]')
        fi
        # ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo.appkind is CRD-validated to a fixed enum
        # (deployment|statefulset|daemonset|deploymentconfig|rollout|job) --
        # "configmap" is rejected outright at admission time. This fault always
        # targets a configmap, never any other kind, so hardcode it here instead
        # of trusting TARGETS' kind component (the ChaosEngine submission uses
        # a dummy CRD-valid appkind like "deployment" purely to satisfy the
        # schema; only appns/applabel need to vary per submission).
        APP_KIND="configmap"
        echo "Resolving target ${APP_KIND}/flagd-config in ns=${APP_NAMESPACE}"
        CURRENT=$(kubectl get "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" flagd-config -o jsonpath='{.data.demo\.flagd\.json}')
        if [ -z "$CURRENT" ]; then
          echo "ConfigMap flagd-config has no 'demo.flagd.json' data key" >&2
          exit 1
        fi

        if ! printf '%s\n' "$CURRENT" | grep -q "\"${FLAG_NAME}\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*{"; then
          echo "flag '${FLAG_NAME}' not found in demo.flagd.json flags map" >&2
          exit 1
        fi

        # Prints the current defaultVariant of the named flag's JSON object
        # (empty if the flag has no defaultVariant field).
        extract_variant() {
          awk -v flag="$1" '
            BEGIN { in_block=0; depth=0; found=0 }
            {
              line = $0
              if (!in_block) {
                if (match(line, "\"" flag "\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\{")) { in_block=1; depth=1; next }
              } else {
                if (depth == 1 && found == 0 && match(line, /"defaultVariant"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"/)) {
                  val = line
                  sub(/^.*"defaultVariant"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"/, "", val)
                  sub(/".*$/, "", val)
                  print val
                  found = 1
                }
                opens = gsub(/\{/, "{", line); closes = gsub(/\}/, "}", line)
                depth += opens - closes
                if (depth <= 0) in_block = 0
              }
            }
          '
        }

        # Rewrites the named flag's defaultVariant in place; every other byte
        # of the JSON document (other flags, ordering, description, etc.) is
        # left untouched so the revert is byte-exact.
        patch_variant() {
          awk -v flag="$1" -v newval="$2" '
            BEGIN { in_block=0; depth=0; found=0 }
            {
              line = $0
              if (!in_block) {
                if (match(line, "\"" flag "\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\\{")) { in_block=1; depth=1; print line; next }
              } else {
                if (depth == 1 && found == 0 && match(line, /"defaultVariant"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"/)) {
                  sub(/"defaultVariant"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"[^"]*"/, "\"defaultVariant\": \"" newval "\"", line)
                  found = 1
                }
                opens = gsub(/\{/, "{", line); closes = gsub(/\}/, "}", line)
                depth += opens - closes
                if (depth <= 0) in_block = 0
              }
              print line
            }
          '
        }

        apply_configmap() {
          # $1 = full new demo.flagd.json content; JSON-escape it and merge-patch
          # it back into the single opaque data key (no jq/python in this image).
          ESCAPED=$(printf '%s\n' "$1" | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g' | awk '{printf "%s\\n", $0}')
          kubectl patch "${APP_KIND}" -n "${APP_NAMESPACE}" flagd-config --type=merge \
            -p "{\"data\":{\"demo.flagd.json\":\"${ESCAPED}\"}}"
        }

        ORIG_VARIANT=$(printf '%s\n' "$CURRENT" | extract_variant "${FLAG_NAME}")
        ORIG_VARIANT="${ORIG_VARIANT:-${FLAG_REVERT_STATE}}"
        echo "flag=${FLAG_NAME} originalDefaultVariant=${ORIG_VARIANT}"

        echo "Injecting: setting ${FLAG_NAME}.defaultVariant=${FLAG_STATE}"
        INJECTED=$(printf '%s\n' "$CURRENT" | patch_variant "${FLAG_NAME}" "${FLAG_STATE}")
        apply_configmap "$INJECTED"

        echo "Holding fault for ${TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION}s"
        sleep "${TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION}"

        echo "Reverting: restoring ${FLAG_NAME}.defaultVariant=${ORIG_VARIANT}"
        REVERTED=$(printf '%s\n' "$INJECTED" | patch_variant "${FLAG_NAME}" "${ORIG_VARIANT}")
        apply_configmap "$REVERTED"
    env:
      # Injected by the chaos-operator from ChaosEngine.spec.appinfo. This
      # fault targets the flagd-config ConfigMap by a fixed name, not by
      # label, so APP_LABEL is declared for interface consistency with other
      # first-class faults but is not used by the script.
      - name: APP_NAMESPACE
        value: "otel-demo"
      - name: APP_LABEL
        value: ""
      - name: APP_KIND
        value: "configmap"

      # name of the feature flag to toggle, matching a key under
      # flagd-config's demo.flagd.json ".flags" map (e.g. loadGeneratorFloodHomepage,
      # adHighCpu, productCatalogFailure, ...)
      - name: FLAG_NAME
        value: "loadGeneratorFloodHomepage"

      # value written to the flag's "defaultVariant" field during injection
      - name: FLAG_STATE
        value: "on"

      # fallback revert value used only if the flag's original defaultVariant
      # could not be captured before injection; normally the captured
      # original value is used so the revert is exact
      - name: FLAG_REVERT_STATE
        value: "off"

      - name: TOTAL_CHAOS_DURATION
        value: "300"

    labels:
      name: opentelemetry-demo-feature-flag
      app.kubernetes.io/part-of: litmus
      app.kubernetes.io/component: experiment-job
      app.kubernetes.io/version: ci

args: kubectl apply -f /tmp/ -n {{workflow.parameters.adminModeNamespace}} && echo "ChaosExperiment CRDs ready: $(kubectl get chaosexperiments -n {{workflow.parameters.adminModeNamespace}} --no-headers | wc -l)"
